summary: Settings > Automation Execution > System sets the base URL, Proxy IP allowed list (empty means REMOTE_HOST_HEADERS are trusted unconditionally), analytics and subscription client IDs and secrets, global default execution environment, custom virtualenv paths, analytics gather interval and Remote Host Headers such as HTTP_X_FORWARDED_FOR.
questions: How do I set the base URL for controller notifications?
How do I trust X-Forwarded-For behind a load balancer?
Where is the global default execution environment set?
What is the Proxy IP allowed list?
